spec.hotspot_cell: each detection is assigned to the nearest source point (haversine); counts binned by SGT hour of (detection + latency)
spec.wind_components: u=-wspd*sin(dir), v=-wspd*cos(dir) (dir = direction wind comes FROM); along = u*sin(b)+v*cos(b), cross = u*cos(b)-v*sin(b), b = bearing source->SG
spec.windows: trailing, inclusive of origin hour, strict (any missing hour -> NaN); fut_* use hours t+1..t+n
spec.arrival_doc: per detection: wind=IDW of trailing-6h mean u,v at the 7 points; along/cross vs bearing detection->SG; eta_h=dist_km/(3.6*along); contrib=frp*exp(-dist/decay_km)*exp(-(theta/theta0)^2); bin if eta - (t - t_det) in (lo,hi]
